title: ‘Zombified’ C.D.C., Hobbled by Cuts, Struggles to Fulfill Scientific Mission
summary: The agency has lost its independence and nearly a third of its staff, as Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and associates have tightened control.
